title: Drinking around the world
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why do drinking customs differ so much between countries?
Can alcohol be an important part of social culture without causing unhealthy pressure?
How should someone refuse a drink politely in a culture where drinking is expected?
Do you think younger generations are changing attitudes toward alcohol?
